topic: Sources and Uses of Heat and Light
key_concepts: Some objects are sources of heat and light
The sun is a natural source of heat and light
Fireflies and volcanoes are natural sources of light or heat
Table lamps and traffic lights are artificial sources of light
Heat and light have everyday uses
Keeping a safe distance from the television reduces light entering the eyes
Hot pots and stoves should not be touched while cooking
Umbrellas or hats protect against the sun's heat at noon
Playing outside under extreme heat is unsafe
Candles should be kept away from flammable objects and placed on nonflammable holders
Tongs should be used when grilling to avoid burns
